description: This Java class defines a data model for tax configuration settings within a shopping or e-commerce application. It includes properties for tax calculation basis and flags for collecting tax under specific geographic conditions, and implements JSON serialization.

classes.name: TaxConfiguration
classes.description: A model class representing various tax configuration options, including the basis for tax calculation and conditions for tax collection based on geographic relationships.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the tax configuration object into a JSON string, including the tax basis calculation.

methods.name: setTaxBasisCalculation
methods.description: Sets the tax basis calculation method.

methods.name: getTaxBasisCalculation
methods.description: Retrieves the current tax basis calculation method.

methods.name: setCollectTaxIfDifferentProvinceOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Sets whether to collect tax when the customer is in a different province.

methods.name: isCollectTaxIfDifferentProvinceOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Checks if tax should be collected in a different province.

methods.name: setCollectTaxIfDifferentCountryOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Sets whether to collect tax when the customer is in a different country.

methods.name: isCollectTaxIfDifferentCountryOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Checks if tax should be collected in a different country.
